_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Integrated Circuit Chip and Cell Logic Simulation and Test Pattern Verification Report
summary: Documents the logical description of each cell and chip used for simulation and test pattern verification of an integrated circuit, including normal and faulted configurations.
description_purpose: This data is the documentation of the logical description of each cell and chip used for simulation and test pattern verification of an integrated circuit. This description will include both the normal and faulted configurations of each cell and chip.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This data item interrelates with DI-MCCR-80499 and DI-MCCR-80500.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be prepared using on 8 1/2 x 11 inch paper. Throughout this data item the term "cell" shall be defined as "a primitive logic element"; e.g., Inverter, NAND, NOR, flip-flop, etc., and shall not include complex functions such as counters, registers, etc.

preparation_instructions.title: Contents.
preparation_instructions.content: The Integrated Circuit Chip and Cell Logic Simulation and Test Pattern Verification report shall include:

children.title: A description of the type of faults to be detected.
A brief description of the computer program and or manual technique used in the simulation and test pattern verification shall be provided and shall include:
The name of the computer program and, if available to the Government, where it can be obtained.
The data and revision of the program used.
The number of faulted and normal states that can be simulated or verified, e.g. 0, 1, X, etc.
A description of the conditions required for a fault to be considered detected.
A complete list of assumptions made (if applicable) in modeling cells and performing chip simulations and test pattern verifications.
A complete description of the logic implementations of each cell shall be provided. This description shall include:
Logic truth table including the normal and faulted conditions.
A list for each cell of any normal or faulted condition not included in the logical model due to limitations in the computer program manual technique, etc.

The listing(s) of the chip simulation and test pattern verification shall be provided. Sufficient data shall be provided with the listing to enable the Government to interpret the form and format of the listing(s). This listing(s) shall include:
The input stimulus and response of the normal or unfaulted condition of the chip. This stimulus shall be identified to the input used in test pattern verification.
A list of the undetected faults clearly identified and traceable back to the chip logic diagram.
The percent test pattern grading level achieved with the input stimulus provided.
